title: The Fortune Hunter
author: David Graham Phillips
description: "The Fortune Hunter" by David Graham Phillips is a novel written in the early 20th century.
longDescription: The story centers around the ambitious and charismatic protagonist, Mr. Feuerstein, an actor who is both enamored with dreams of success and mired in the realities of financial struggle.

authorInfo.bio: David Graham Phillips (1867–1911) is the author of The Fortune Hunter. This historical edition is part of the author’s surviving literary work. Explore the linked biographical record for their life and bibliography.
